lines.japanese: きゃっほう！　今日の授業おしまい～ん♪
lines.english: Yahoo! Classes are over for today!

lines.japanese: さて、待ちに待った放課後はどうしようかな。
lines.english: Now, what should I do with the long-awaited hours after school?

lines.japanese: バイトが非番だから羽を伸ばしたい気分だけど、さりとて愛しの日和子さんは今日もお仕事だし。
lines.english: With no work shift, I felt like spreading my wings, but my beloved Hiyoko had work again today.

lines.japanese: なんてウキウキしながら考えを巡らせていると。
lines.english: I was cheerfully considering my options when—

lines.japanese: 「羽田君──」
lines.english: “Haneda—”

lines.japanese: 「──じゃないのか。ちぇ」
lines.english: “—or not. Damn.”

lines.japanese: うわあ、白々しい。何をいまさら。
lines.english: Wow, how transparent. Why bother at this point?

lines.japanese: 「あのねえ、だから、この先はずっと俺だって言ってるじゃないすか」
lines.english: “Listen. I keep telling you, it's going to be me from now on.”

lines.japanese: 「またまた」
lines.english: “Sure, sure.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、御冗談とかじゃなくて」
lines.english: “I'm not joking.”

lines.japanese: 「認めない」
lines.english: “I refuse to accept it.”

lines.japanese: 「俺という存在を？　勘弁してくださいよ、傷付くなあ」
lines.english: “My very existence? Please, that hurts.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなのお互いさまじゃん。こっちだって、羽田君が本当にいなくなっちゃったら傷付くわけだし」
lines.english: “That makes two of us. If Haneda really disappears, I'll be hurt too.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから……」
lines.english: “No, I mean...”

lines.japanese: もうタラレバじゃなくて「本当に」なんですってば。
lines.english: It wasn't an *if.* He really had.

lines.japanese: タカシ君が現れなくなって約二週間。この現実は、彼女に対してどのような効果を生んだのでしょう。
lines.english: Nearly two weeks had passed since Takashi last appeared. What effect had that reality had on her?

lines.japanese: 少なくとも、まだ希望を捨てさせるほど長い空白ではなかったようです。
lines.english: At the very least, the absence had not yet lasted long enough to rob her of hope.

lines.japanese: 「明日香さん、ひとつ真面目な質問よろしいでしょうか」
lines.english: “Asuka, may I ask you one serious question?”

lines.japanese: 「なに」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「アナタいつまで彼を待つつもりなんですか」
lines.english: “How long do you intend to wait for him?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「二学期が終わるまで？　卒業するまで？　それとも……」
lines.english: “Until the end of the second term? Graduation? Or...”

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ」
lines.english: “What's that supposed to mean?”

lines.japanese: 明日香さんは俺の詰問を失笑で遮りました。
lines.english: Asuka cut off my interrogation with a derisive laugh.

lines.japanese: 「おかしくない？　なんか羽田君が戻ってこないこと前提になってる」
lines.english: “Isn't that strange? You're assuming Haneda won't come back.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃあ」
lines.english: “Of course.”

lines.japanese: そうなんですから。言ってるでしょ、何度も。
lines.english: Because he wouldn't. I had told her again and again.
“Sigh...”

lines.japanese: 本当は俺だって言いたくないんすよ、こんなん。
lines.english: I didn't want to say these things either.

lines.japanese: 俺、道化ですよ。笑わせ役っすよ。憎まれ役なんていちばんやりたくないっすよ。
lines.english: I was a clown. My role was making people laugh. Playing the villain was the last thing I wanted.

lines.japanese: それに、ややこしくなるから口では「消えた」なんて無粋な言い方してるけど──
lines.english: And I called them “gone” only because anything else made the explanation too complicated—

lines.japanese: ──本当はタカシ君も他のみんなも、ずっと俺の中でいっしょに生きつづけてるって、個人的にはそういう風に考えてるんです。
lines.english: —but personally, I believed Takashi and all the others would go on living inside me forever.

lines.japanese: 「ま、いいや」
lines.english: “Oh, well.”

lines.japanese: どう説明したところで、けっきょく明日香さんには恨まれるわけだし。
lines.english: No matter how I explained, Asuka would resent me in the end.

lines.japanese: や、このひとだけじゃないか。京さんも蔵人君も、今朝の電車で会ったあの子も、その他タカシ君のお友達みんな。
lines.english: And not only her. Kyou, Kuroudo, the girl on the train this morning, and all Takashi's other friends.

lines.japanese: さらには隼人君のお友達もみんな。
lines.english: All of Hayato's friends too.

lines.japanese: 伽楼羅君の帰りを待ってたカケル君も。
lines.english: Kakeru, who had waited for Karura to return.

lines.japanese: ヨージ君の帰りを待ってた小鳩さんも。
lines.english: Kobato, who had waited for Youji.

lines.japanese: いずれは色んなひとが俺を恨むのかもしれない。
lines.english: Someday, all kinds of people might resent me.

lines.japanese: うそーん。やだやだ、こわい。ひとに嫌われるの超こわい。
lines.english: No waaay. I hated that. Scary. Being hated frightened me more than anything.

lines.japanese: なんつって、だったらヘラヘラ笑ってりゃいいよ。うん、もともと俺そういうやつだし。笑っとけ笑っとけ。
lines.english: Just kidding. If so, all I had to do was keep grinning. That was who I had always been. Smile, smile.

lines.japanese: あーっはっは、へらへら。
lines.english: Ahahaha. Grin, grin.

lines.japanese: 「……なんで泣きそうな顔してんすか」
lines.english: “...Why do you look ready to cry?”

lines.japanese: 「アレっ！？　今こそヘラヘラ指摘するトキですよ！？」
lines.english: “What?! This was your cue to point out my idiotic grin!”

lines.japanese: 「泣きたいのは私の方だっての」
lines.english: “I'm the one who wants to cry.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、俺泣いてないしね！？」
lines.english: “I'm not crying, okay?!”

lines.japanese: アゲてこうアゲてこう。朝から晩までぬるっと行こう。今日も元気にコンバンワ！
lines.english: Keep those spirits up, up, up! Slip and slide from morning to night! Another bright and cheery good evening to you!

lines.japanese: 「……あ、へらへら戻った」
lines.english: “...Oh. The stupid grin is back.”

lines.japanese: 「イェイ！」
lines.english: “Yeah!”

lines.japanese: 「そーそ。羽田君と違って憂いのキャラは似合わないから、そういうカオしてた方がいいと思う」
lines.english: “That's better. Brooding doesn't suit you the way it suited Haneda. You should wear that face.”

lines.japanese: 「惚れるなよ？」
lines.english: “Don't fall for me.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえよ」
lines.english: “Never.”

lines.japanese: はは、明日香さんは強いなあ。ちっともサガらないもんなあ。こういうところは見習いたいものです。
lines.english: Haha. Asuka was strong. Nothing brought her down. I could learn from that part of her.

lines.japanese: 「ええと、明日香さんも笑ったカオのが可愛いですよ」
lines.english: “Well, you're cuter when you smile too.”

lines.japanese: 「知ってます」
lines.english: “I know.”

lines.japanese: うわ、謙遜とかしないんだ。すごいな、学園のプリンセス。
lines.english: Wow, no modesty whatsoever. The academy princess was incredible.

lines.japanese: 「ま、怒ったカオも可愛いとは思いますけど」
lines.english: “Though I think you're cute when you're angry too.”

lines.japanese: 「よく言われます」
lines.english: “I hear that often.”

lines.japanese: すげー、真顔で全肯定すげー。
lines.english: Amazing. She accepted every compliment with a straight face.

lines.japanese: 「要はどんなカオしてても可愛いンすよね」
lines.english: “Basically, you're cute no matter what expression you wear.”

lines.japanese: 「もはや聞き飽きました」
lines.english: “I've heard it all before.”

lines.japanese: すげえええ！　プリンセスかっけえええー！
lines.english: Amazing! The princess was so cool!

lines.japanese: 「でも日和子さんには負けるかな」
lines.english: “But Hiyoko might have you beat.”

lines.japanese: 「知ってます」
lines.english: “I know.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？　そこは『なんだと』じゃ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Wasn't that where you were supposed to say, ‘Excuse me’?”

lines.japanese: 「あの子はちゃんと内面も可愛いから。ああいうのが本物だよね」
lines.english: “She's adorable on the inside too. That's the genuine article.”

lines.japanese: ほう……分かっていらっしゃる。
lines.english: Oh... She understood.

lines.japanese: しかし恋人をそんな風に誉められては、まるで我がことのように嬉しくなってしまいますね。てへへ。
lines.english: Hearing my girlfriend praised like that made me happy as though she had praised me. Tee-hee.

lines.japanese: 「おっさんおっさん、ヘラヘラ通りこしてニタニタになってる」
lines.english: “Old man, you've passed grinning and gone all the way to smirking.”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、笑う門には何とやらっすよ。ほら、明日香さんも笑って笑って」
lines.english: “Laughter brings good fortune and all that. Come on, Asuka, smile.”

lines.japanese: 「私、笑いたくないときは笑わない主義」
lines.english: “I don't smile when I don't feel like it.”

lines.japanese: 「あっそ」
lines.english: “Fine.”

lines.japanese: なんだ、やっぱり俺たち似てないや。道化のイーグルは笑いたくないときこそ笑う主義でござーい。
lines.english: So we weren't alike after all. Eagle the Clown smiled most when he least felt like it.

lines.japanese: 「笑顔は羽田君が帰ってきたとき用にとっとくよね」
lines.english: “I'm saving my smiles for when Haneda comes back.”

lines.japanese: 「またそういうことを……」
lines.english: “Not this again...”

lines.japanese: アナタね、そうやって、一生ずっと喪に服してるつもりですか？
lines.english: Did she intend to spend her entire life in mourning?

lines.japanese: あのね明日香さん、それを言うなら遅かったんですよ。彼が帰ってきたらじゃなくて、彼が行ってしまう前にもっと笑顔を向けてあげるべきだったんです。
lines.english: Listen, Asuka. It was too late for that. Instead of smiling when he came back, you should have smiled at him more before he left.

lines.japanese: そうであれば、きっと今ごろ違う未来もあったはずです。
lines.english: If you had, surely things would have turned out differently by now.

lines.japanese: 「てかー、したら私と羽田君との約束はどーしてくれんすか」
lines.english: “More importantly, what about the promise Haneda made me?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、うちのタカシがなにかアナタと約束しましたっけ？」
lines.english: “Did our Takashi promise you something?”

lines.japanese: 「ぴこぴこ屋さんに連れてってくれるって話だったんだよね」
lines.english: “He said he’d take me to one of those beep-boop game shops.”

lines.japanese: ぴこぴこ。という言葉がトリガーになって、頭にタカシ君の記憶が浮かびあがってきました。
lines.english: Beep-boop. Those words triggered a memory of Takashi’s.

lines.japanese: 一緒になった彼らの知識や経験は、こうして何かのきっかけで不意に≪思いだす≫ことがあります。それは一般的なエピソード記憶と同じで、印象的なものほど克明に蘇るのです。
lines.english: The knowledge and experience of those who had joined with me sometimes returned unexpectedly when something prompted me. Like ordinary episodic memory, the most powerful experiences came back most vividly.

lines.japanese: 「ん……なるほど。たしかにしましたね、そんな約束」
lines.english: “Hmm... I see. He did make that promise.”

lines.japanese: しかも俺は──タカシ君だったときの俺は、その約束の成就を心待ちにしていたのでした。けっきょく流れていまに至りますけど。
lines.english: And I—or rather, the me who had been Takashi—had looked forward to fulfilling it. In the end, the plan fell through and remained so today.

lines.japanese: 「明日香さんって、ゲームとかやるひとでしたっけ？」
lines.english: “I didn't think you played games.”

lines.japanese: 「全然。ただこないだ、あるひとに教えてもらったタイトルがあって。めっちゃ気になってるんですよねェ～？」
lines.english: “I don't. But somebody told me about a title recently, and now I'm *very* curious about it.”

lines.japanese: ねェ～、なんつって意味ありげに笑われても。
lines.english: She gave that last phrase a pointed smile, but what was I supposed to do with it?

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: としか返しようがありません。
lines.english: There was no other answer.

lines.japanese: 「てゆわけだから付きあってください」
lines.english: “So come with me.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？　俺？　なんで、約束したのはタカシ君でしょ」
lines.english: “Huh? Me? Why? You made the promise with Takashi.”

lines.japanese: 「今後は自分を羽田タカシと思えっつーたのは誰」
lines.english: “Who told me to treat him as Takashi Haneda from now on?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、俺ですねえ」
lines.english: “Oh. That was me.”

lines.japanese: 「自らの発言には責任を持つように」
lines.english: “Take responsibility for your own words.”

lines.japanese: なるほど、理には適ってる。
lines.english: That was logical.

lines.japanese: それにまあ、約束は約束ですしね。うちのタカシ君が世話になってた恩もあるし、まあ、そのぐらいは。
lines.english: Besides, a promise was a promise. Takashi owed her for everything she had done for him. I could at least do this much.

lines.japanese: 「ようがす、分かりましたお供しましょう。いずれ機会があれば」
lines.english: “Very well. I shall accompany you when the opportunity arises.”

lines.japanese: 「今日は？」
lines.english: “What about today?”

lines.japanese: 「今日っすか。今日は……」
lines.english: “Today? Today...”

lines.japanese: 「いや、俺は大丈夫なんですけど、日和子さんがバイト入ってるんで。また日を改めて三人で──」
lines.english: “I'm free, but Hiyoko has work. Let's pick another day and the three of us can—”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ今日がいい」
lines.english: “Today is better.”
“—huh?”

lines.japanese: 「むしろ今日がいい」
lines.english: “In fact, I specifically want today.”

lines.japanese: 「や、ですから……」
lines.english: “But as I said...”

lines.japanese: 「今日がいい」
lines.english: “Today.”

lines.japanese: ん？　んん？　なんだろう、このひと、このぐらいの空気は読めるはずなのに。
lines.english: Hm? Hmm? She could ordinarily read a situation this obvious.

lines.japanese: 仕方ない、あんまりカッコ良くないけどズバリ言うか。
lines.english: Fine. It wasn't elegant, but I would say it outright.

lines.japanese: 「ええとですね、ご存知のとおり、俺いま特定の方と交際しておりますんで。他の女性とマンツーでお出掛けなんてのは、倫理上あまり好ましくないわけですよ」
lines.english: “As you know, I'm currently in a committed relationship. Ethically speaking, going out alone with another woman is rather inappropriate.”

lines.japanese: 「でも今日がいい」
lines.english: “Today is still better.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そーすかー」
lines.english: “Oh. I see.”

lines.japanese: わがままなお姫様ですこと。
lines.english: What a selfish princess.

lines.japanese: 「えーと、それじゃ、京さんか蔵人君あたり誘って──」
lines.english: “Then let's invite Kyou or Kuroudo—”

lines.japanese: 「山科、チャイムと同時にロケット下校。針生先輩、とっくに無断早退」
lines.english: “Yamashina launched herself home with the bell. Hariu left without permission ages ago.”

lines.japanese: 「わお、まいったな。じゃあ誰を誘おう、昌子さん……は来るわけないか」
lines.english: “Wow, what a problem. Who else? Masako... would never come.”

lines.japanese: ていうか俺、あのひと苦手。
lines.english: Besides, I never knew how to deal with her.

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、そしたら安男君とか──」
lines.english: “Oh, then Yasuo—”

lines.japanese: 「あの、私が約束したのは羽田君なんですけど」
lines.english: “I made the promise with Haneda.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君だけなんですけど」
lines.english: “Only Haneda.”

lines.japanese: なにそれ。
lines.english: What was that supposed to mean?

lines.japanese: あー。
lines.english: Oh.

lines.japanese: あー、もしかして。
lines.english: Oh, could it be?

lines.japanese: 「ふたりで？　だけで？」
lines.english: “Just the two of us?”

lines.japanese: つまりは。
lines.english: In other words.

lines.japanese: 「デート？　したいの？　羽田君と？」
lines.english: “Do you want a date? With Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 睨まれました。
lines.english: She glared at me.

lines.japanese: 「そーゆんじゃない」
lines.english: “It isn't like that.”

lines.japanese: と言いつつ、気のせいかな、ビミョーに顔赤くなってません？
lines.english: She said so, but was I imagining the faint blush on her face?

lines.japanese: 「明日香さん、あのね……」
lines.english: “Asuka, listen...”

lines.japanese: 思わず哀れんだ声が出てしまいました。
lines.english: Pity slipped into my voice.

lines.japanese: いや、だって、ねえ。
lines.english: Because, well...

lines.japanese: 「ほんと、もう、なんて謝ったらいいか分かんないすけど……」
lines.english: “I honestly don't know how to apologize anymore...”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい、だから俺タカシ君じゃないの。いくらソト見が同じだからって、中身違う男とデートしてアナタ楽しいんですか」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, but I'm not Takashi. Even if the outside looks the same, will going on a date with a different man inside make you happy?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなん関係ない。ゲーム見に行くだけだもん」
lines.english: “That doesn't matter. We're only going to look at a game.”

lines.japanese: ……そうですか？
lines.english: ...Are we?

lines.japanese: はて、デートじゃないって言うなら、二人きりのシチュエーションを作って何を企んでるんでしょうね、このお姫さまは。
lines.english: If this wasn't a date, what did the princess hope to accomplish by arranging for us to be alone?

lines.japanese: なんか関わりたくねぇー。思わず天井を仰いで、後ろ頭をがしがし掻いてしまいました。
lines.english: I wanted no part of it. I looked at the ceiling and scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「約束したのに」
lines.english: “But you promised.”

lines.japanese: だけど向きなおったとき、凛と立っていた彼女の姿が年老いたみたいに小さく見えたものですから──
lines.english: Yet when I faced her again, the proud girl standing there seemed suddenly small and old—
“Sigh...”

lines.japanese: ──つい同情してしまいました。
lines.english: —and I couldn't help feeling sorry for her.

lines.japanese: 「ようがす。本日お供いたしやしょう」
lines.english: “Very well. I shall accompany you today.”

lines.japanese: なにか狙いがあるのかもしれませんが、それで彼女の気が済むというなら誘いに乗ってあげましょう。
lines.english: Perhaps she had some ulterior purpose, but if indulging her would settle the matter, I would accept.

lines.japanese: ひとつには、俺たちの厄介な事情に少なからず巻きこんでしまったことへの責任として。
lines.english: Partly out of responsibility for involving her in our troublesome circumstances.

lines.japanese: 「でも筋は通してきます。ちょっと待っててください」
lines.english: “But first, I'll do this properly. Wait here.”

lines.japanese: 事後報告では不実だと思うので、出かける前に日和子さんへ一報入れておきましょう。まだ教室に残ってればいいんですけど。
lines.english: Telling Hiyoko afterward would feel dishonest, so I would notify her before we left. Hopefully, she was still in her classroom.

lines.japanese: 「ええと、二年Ｂ組ってどこでしたっけ」
lines.english: “Um, where was Class 2-B?”

lines.japanese: 「玉泉んトコ？　行く必要ないと思うけど」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi's room? You don't need to go.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで！」
lines.english: “Why not?!”

lines.japanese: 「そこにいるから」
lines.english: “She's right there.”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 慌てて振りかえると、またしても日和子さんが戸口の向こうでモジついておりました。
lines.english: I whirled around. Once again, Hiyoko stood fidgeting beyond the doorway.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと！　だからそういうことは先に教えてくださいって！」
lines.english: “Hey! Tell me these things first!”

lines.japanese: 「や、今度はほんとにいま気付いた」
lines.english: “No, I really did just notice this time.”

lines.japanese: とかなんとか言ってる明日香さんを置いて、俺は廊下へ駆けだしていきました。
lines.english: Leaving Asuka and her excuses behind, I dashed into the hall.

lines.japanese: 「ど、どうしたんすか日和子さん」
lines.english: “Wh-what's wrong, Hiyoko?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いえ、すみません何度も」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. Sorry to come by again.”

lines.japanese: 校内ではあまり接触しないという≪取り決め≫を気にして、だいぶ恐縮しておいでです。
lines.english: Our agreement to avoid meeting at school plainly made her feel apologetic.

lines.japanese: 「先輩、今日バイトないですよね。お店で会えないから、帰る前に一言挨拶しておきたくて」
lines.english: “You don’t work today, do you? Since I won’t see you at the restaurant, I wanted to say goodbye before leaving school.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、それでわざわざ？」
lines.english: “Y-you came all this way for that?”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、あと……問題なければ、駅まで一緒に帰れないかなぁ、って」
lines.english: “Yes, and... if it isn't a problem, I wondered whether we might walk to the station together.”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、日和子さんっ……！」
lines.english: “H-Hiyoko...!”

lines.japanese: ぶわっ（心の涙）。
lines.english: A flood of tears. (In my heart.)

lines.japanese: ななな、なんと嬉しいことを。ああ、胸がなにか甘いシロップのようなもので満たされそうだ。
lines.english: What a delightful thing to say! Something like sweet syrup threatened to fill my chest.

lines.japanese: どうやらうちの彼女さんは、昼休みのうきうきテンションがこの時間まで継続中の御様子。
lines.english: Apparently, my girlfriend's cheerful mood from lunch had persisted until now.

lines.japanese: っていうのに、ここからどう話題転換して明日香さんとの件を切りだせばいいのかしら。
lines.english: And yet I somehow had to change the subject and raise the matter of Asuka.

lines.japanese: ヘタな説明をしちゃうとヘンな勘違いされて、男女のトライアングルな問題へと発展しかねません。順を追って慎重に事情を伝えたいところです。
lines.english: A clumsy explanation could cause a strange misunderstanding and develop into a romantic triangle. I needed to explain everything carefully, in order.

lines.japanese: 「えー、えーと、ですね……いま丁度、俺の方も日和子さんに話があったんですけど……」
lines.english: “Um, well... As it happens, I had something to discuss with you too...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なになに？」
lines.english: “Oh! What is it? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、そんな身を乗りだしていただいても、べつに愉快な話では」
lines.english: “No need to lean in so eagerly. It isn't exactly amusing news.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ？　ふうん、じゃあ歩きながら聞きます──」
lines.english: “It isn't? Then you can tell me while we walk—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、一緒に帰ってくれるなら、ですけど」
lines.english: “—if you’re walking back with me, of course.”

lines.japanese: なんつってタマちゃんニッコリ。ああ、まさか俺が断るだなんて夢にも思っていないその笑顔。間の悪いことに、いつになくゴキゲンですよこの子。
lines.english: Tama smiled. She never dreamed I might refuse. Through spectacularly poor timing, she was in an unusually wonderful mood.

lines.japanese: 「いや、その、すいません、それがですね」
lines.english: “Well, um, I'm sorry, but...”

lines.japanese: 焦るな、慎重に行けよ俺。よーく言葉を選んで話すんだ。
lines.english: Don't panic. Be careful. Choose your words.

lines.japanese: 「実はさっき知った話なんですけど、以前ちょっと学校でゲームの話をしたときに──」
lines.english: “I only learned this just now, but when I talked about games at school once before—”

lines.japanese: 「たまいずみー、彼氏貸してー、ひとりでいいからー」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, lend me your boyfriend! Just one of him!”
“What?”

lines.japanese: だ、台無しだ……。
lines.english: R-ruined...

lines.japanese: 「あの、どういうことですか」
lines.english: “What does she mean?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、実は俺“以前”明日香さんとゲームショップへ行く約束をしてたみたいでですね」
lines.english: “Well, apparently I made a promise *before* to visit a game store with Asuka.”

lines.japanese: 俺は日和子さんとの共通語（以前という単語を強調する場合は“千歳鷲介ではなかったとき”と同義です）を交えて、詳しく事情を説明しました。
lines.english: Using the word *before* in the special sense Hiyoko and I shared—*when I was not Shuusuke Chitose*—I explained the situation in detail.

lines.japanese: 「はあ、そうですか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: ほらぁー、ひよちゃんテンション下がっちゃったぁー。
lines.english: There. Hiyo's spirits had fallen.

lines.japanese: こうなったからには、やっぱり日和子さんにも誘いをかけないとな。
lines.english: At this point, I ought to invite her too.

lines.japanese: いや、でも現実問題として、彼女はこのあとアレキサンダーのバイトがあるんだ。それを知ってて誘うってのも、かえって白々しいだろうか。
lines.english: But practically speaking, she had a shift at Alexander. Inviting her when I knew that might seem even more insincere.

lines.japanese: うーん、どうしよう。
lines.english: Hmm. What should I do?
